objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Exploit the json web token weakness of a Next.js frontend with an S3-compatible storage service behind nginx and recover the flag (FLAG{...}) it guards.
hints: Decode the token and check which of its parts the server really verifies.
Read what the application exposes beyond its intended pages.

steps.title: Identify the stack
steps.prompt: Which framework or language runs the application? (name only)

steps.title: Name the weakness
steps.prompt: Which token format carries the session and its claims?

steps.title: Identify the storage
steps.prompt: Which storage API does the back service imitate?
